To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) the transport of ions across the plasma membrane is essential for the maintenance of the intracellular environment, (b) ion transport can be passive (down a chemical gradient) and active (up a chemical gradient), and (c) the mechanisms of ion transport are mediated by specific transport proteins.

1) a single membrane protein can perform multiple ion transport functions; 2) the same ion can be transported by different proteins; 3) the same protein can transport different ions; 4) the same ion transport function can be performed by different proteins; and 5) the same membrane protein can transport ions in both directions

(1) the transport of Na+ ions across membranes is an active process that involves the hydrolysis of ATP, which in turn is coupled to the transport of Na+, and (2) the Na+/K+-ATPase is the primary mechanism for the transport of Na+.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms of ion transport in cell membranes and the regulation of ion transport by hormones.
the mechanisms of transport across cell membranes, with a special focus on the role of the membrane potential and of ion transporters in the regulation of cell volume.
the mechanisms of ion transport across the cell membranes.
